name: Sports Scarf
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from high-quality poly fabric, this custom sports scarf is lightweight, soft, and comfortable to wear throughout the year.

- Each scarf features a tassel finish on both ends, giving it that timeless, classic supporter scarf look and feel.

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

Designed in a standard fan scarf size for maximum visibility and comfort:

- Overall Length:  65 in (166 cm)

-  Width:  7 in (18 cm)

-  Tassel Length:  5.5 in (14 cm)

Its generous size makes it perfect for wearing around the neck, displaying at sporting events, or hanging as a decorative keepsake.

 

  • Printing Technology:

Printed using advanced sublimation technology, ensuring vibrant colors, sharp details, and full-surface customization on both sides. The design is permanently infused into the fabric, resulting in long-lasting graphics that won't crack, peel, or fade easily.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

More than just a fan accessory, this sports scarf is ideal for:

- Supporting your favorite sports team at games and tournaments

- Showcasing club logos, player names, school mascots, or custom artwork

- Displaying as wall décor, memorabilia, or collector's items

- Team events, championships, fundraisers, and fan gatherings

- Creating a personalized statement for athletes, coaches, and supporters

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A custom sports scarf makes a meaningful gift for sports enthusiasts, athletes, coaches, students, and loyal fans. Perfect for birthdays, team celebrations, championship victories, graduation events, holidays, Father's Day, Christmas, or any special occasion where team pride and personal memories deserve to be celebrated.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xSports Scarf

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
